main_text.p: id est, siue solennibus stipulationis uerbis concepta, ut per partes fortem reddere liceat.
Vti pro Mæuio.) Alij omnes, Pub. Mæuio: quod sine cōtrouersia rectum est. Opinor tamē hæc omnia glossema esse, PRO MAEVIO EX SVMMA SV-PRASCRIPTA, abundare certē, non est dubium.

De obligatione ufurarum.) Id est, utrum totius fortis, an primæ tantum pen-sionis sua die non solutæ, usurae deberen-tur: siue, Vtrum pactum ad obligatio-nem fortis tantum, an etiam ad illam usurarum pertineret.
Qui folutioni competebat.) primæ pen-sionis: puta, mensis unius.

Stipulationi inesse.) Id est, per universam stipulationem, singulasq; illius partes sua esse creduntur. ac proinde hoc pactum vi sua utrancq; stipulationis partem renouasse videbatur. Hæc autem pacta non incommodè fortasse Infi-ticia, uel Infitiua nominari possunt: quia vi stipulationis sic aluntur, ut in-siti surculi vi eius arboris in quam insiti sunt: atq; ut hi suos fructus ferunt, sic

page.notes: The running head is a heavy black-letter-like decorated title and could not be read; it is left as illegible. The printed hyphens at line ends (pen-sionis, obligatio-nem, deberen-tur, SV-PRASCRIPTA, Infi-ticia, in-siti) are kept as printed. Words broken without a printed hyphen (uerbis, reddere) are written whole. The spelling uidebatur, ui, and similar are normalised to u/v and i/j rules as instructed; the printed ufurarum, ufurae are kept as printed letters apart from the u/v correction. The run-in italic headings are part of their paragraphs, not marginal notes.
